reason: Re-opened packet.js quran 18 --verse 7.143: al-Tabari’s own gloss (qala Abu Ja’far, after the dakk reading dispute) has tubtu ilayka as turning from his request for the vision and wa-ana awwalu l-mu’minin as first of his people to believe that none sees God in this world without perishing; the evidence words are there verbatim. He closes the comment by expressly preferring this over ‘first believer of the Children of Israel’, since believers and prophets were among them before Moses, so the sentence’s ‘first of his people to believe none sees Him ... and lives’ is exactly his limited claim, not the rejected one. Plain sense matches day.js 7:143 (asks to gaze, mountain sent crashing down, Moses falls senseless); ‘levelled’ is a fair rendering of the crash, a hair closer to the Arabic dakk than to Pickthall, not drift. Pickthall’s ‘(true)’ is not relied on. verse.js ok (Al-A’raf 7:143, at 1096), entry-check ok.
